picks.what: Østerågade, the old main street, color postcard
picks.why: only usable P5 view: color postcard of the historic main street with its old merchant houses; dark shadowed foreground cut

gaps: P0–P3: nothing (#1 is an execution in Viborg); P6: only single facades of Aalborg Kloster and a howitzer in a museum
notes: #5 is a street scene, not a general view, but it is labeled Aalborg Østerågade and shows a row of historic houses; drop it if a stricter standard is wanted. #3 (1865 engraving of Østerågade with Jens Bangs Stenhus) is a good landmark scene but only 21 years from the existing 1886 general view, so not added. #6/#7 are aerial photos of Ribe Cathedral (by the firm Aalborg Luftfoto). #4 is a crowd at Budolfi Plads; #8 a harbor crane.
